title: Redesign album and artist list pages
description:
Overhaul the desktop AlbumsPage and ArtistsPage to be more visually interesting, responsive, and content-rich.

**Current issues:**
- Pages are not responsive enough
- Performance/lag issues (image loading)
- Boring/plain design with no visual hierarchy

**Planned improvements:**

1. **Enhanced cards:**
   - Improved AlbumCard with hover-lift, better shadows, subtle scale
   - New ArtistCard component with circular avatars
   
2. **More content/sections:**
   - Stats header ("247 albums • 89 artists • 2,451 songs")
   - Recently added row/carousel at top
   - Alphabet quick-nav for jumping to sections
   
3. **Better grid/responsiveness:**
   - Fluid responsive grid using minmax() instead of fixed breakpoints
   - Keep virtual scrolling for performance
   
4. **Visual polish:**
   - Staggered fade-in animations for cards
   - Better hover states with scale + shadow transitions

title: Android UI redesign
description: Redesign Aurelia Android app UI inspired by PixelPlayer patterns while maintaining unique identity.

comments.author: DESKTOP-1OD2LVU\Marshall
comments.text:
UI redesign completed with PixelPlayer-inspired design:

Theme updates:
- Color.kt: Rich purple palette with proper container colors
- Type.kt: Complete typography scale with all text styles  
- Shape.kt: Larger corner radii (12-50dp) matching modern design
- Theme.kt: Full color scheme with surface container hierarchy

PlayerScreen redesign:
- Gradient background from primaryContainer
- Circular collapse button with inverted colors
- Pill-shaped progress bar with time labels
- Animated playback controls with weight-based expansion
- Play/pause button morphs between rounded square and circle
- Clean metadata section with proper hierarchy

LibraryScreen redesign:
- EnhancedSongItem with animated corner radius (22dp -> 50dp when playing)
- Proper current-song highlighting with primaryContainer
- Album art placeholder with playing state indicator
- Floating mini-player bar with status pill
- Consistent spacing and padding throughout

Build verified successful.

title: Fix favorite button styling in player view
description: The favorite button in the player view uses the wrong button type. When a song is favorited, the background changes to use the accent color. Instead, it should work like the favorite button in the fullscreen player, where it just changes between hollow/filled depending on if the song is favorited.
